what: Product 360° view — dragging sideways rotates a frame set (259 frames by default). Dragging 80% of the screen width makes one full turn and the end loops back to the start, and the frame number is the progress split by frame count and rounded. Firing fx:reset returns to the nearest turn end (front) in .4s power2.out

options.frames: Frame Count — If there is one, that count, otherwise this value (default 259)
options.span: Drag length per turn (ratio of screen width), default .8
options.back: Duration to return to front (sec), default .4

use: — images use img[data-fx-part=frame] group, or el.addEventListener('fx:frame', e => draw(e.detail.progress)). Directly: el.dispatchEvent(new Event('fx:reset'))
note: With touch-action: pan-y, a vertical finger swipe scrolls the page and it rotates only on a sideways swipe

from.where: index.html [data-slot=products] 360 VIEW — a panel for dragging and spinning a watch in three colors
